name: Surface Normal Computation from MDF
definition: Computes surface normals $n(p, v)$ for a point $p$ and associated closest point $v$ using the gradient of the distance function $d(p, v)$, ensuring the normal points away from the surface.
summary: Surface Normal Computation from MDF derives normals by evaluating the gradient of a directed, modulated distance field, avoiding explicit mesh reconstruction by leveraging visibility and orientation information.
